event: Nala turns and sprints down the deer trail for the ford.
The scouts come shrieking after her, keeping their distance, calling her place to the file behind.
Slings whirr. She weaves. One stone hums past; another cracks off a yew.
A third takes her high on the left shoulder. She stumbles, catches herself, and keeps running.
Her sense lays the trail out under her a stride ahead. The roar stays at her back.
A mile and more. Her shoulder throbs; her breath burns. The trees thin.
She bursts out of the Tangle into the morning light and splashes into the ford, knee-deep.
Across the water, behind the drystone wall, Dace's shield rises. Merrit's hand is already glowing.
She scrambles up the bank and over the wall.
Behind her nine goblins pour out of the trees, shrieking, straight for the ford.
The hobgoblin with the maul shoulders to the front, bellowing, and wades in first.
